extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance plots digitised from Figure 3. Figure 3g was skipped as a literature-comparison plot; Figure 3h was skipped as an Arrhenius plot; Figure 4 panels are XPS/DRIFTS mechanistic characterisation rather than plotted CO2 conversion/selectivity/STY. Heat-map panels 3d–f were read from the colour scales and are approximate; GHSV was not stated in the caption for panels 3d/e, so it is left unspecified there.
